name: daily-digest
description: A daily PDF briefing: Berlin weather, calendar, six papers, world markets.

scripts.calendars: node -e "import('./src/config.js').then(async m=>{const c=await m.loadConfig();const {listCalendars}=await import('./src/sources/calendar.js');for(const x of await listCalendars(c))console.log(x.title+'  ('+x.source+')')})"
